panels.name: League conquest

bannerLayer.what: the ousted faction's torn banner falling from the left tower, on its own layer. The flat panel-02 files show the Covenant's (the delivered default); swap in the town's real previous holder.

pick.brigand: banner-brigand (no town is brigand-held in the prototype: data/world.js FACTIONS = league / covenant / nightglass / contested; drawn for the live build and for panel 8)
pick.contested: none: draw the base alone (the town was contested ground, nobody's banner falls)

bannerLayer.factionsNote: factions with a banner = data/world.js FACTIONS minus contested (league, covenant, nightglass) + the brief's brigands (ART-BRIEF section 1). Deserters, free companies and reavers (data/units.js ENEMY_COMPANIES) never hold a town, so they get no layer.
bannerLayer.composite: draw base at the panel's origin, then the faction's layer on top at offset [0, 0], normal blend, no tint. Layers are full-canvas transparent PNGs (alpha 0/255) registered pixel for pixel to their base, so the offset is [0, 0] at every size; bbox gives where the opaque pixels are if you want to crop. base + banner-<faction> == that faction's full render (0 px, checked at all three sizes); base + banner-covenant == the delivered flat files (0 px).
bannerLayer.bboxNote: union over the four factions; 1024x576 = 960x540 + (32, 18); 480x270 = 960x540 / 2. Pixels of the pikes and embers in front of the banner are holes in the layer (they stay on the base), so the stacking is already right.
bannerLayer.gameKeysNote: registry.js loads panels[].layers as p8-panel-<id>-<name> (1024x576 files). Today the player draws only the flat bleed for panel 2 (unchanged, still correct for a Covenant loss); to tell the right loss: draw p8-panel-2-base, then p8-panel-2-banner-<beat.ousted> unless ousted is contested/null (yearstory beats already carry `ousted`).
bannerLayer.colourRule: each layer uses only its faction's ramps (field, emblem, knobs) plus the shared outline (#260a16 / #54063a) and crossbar wood; checked: coloursOutsideFactionAndShared = 0 and otherFactionColourPx = 0 for every faction and size

panels.scene: dusk. A League pike column (P1 pikemen, back view, League colourway, upright pikes) marches up a mud road into a walled town; gold drop banners and pennants on the gatehouse and wall, a torn banner falling from the left tower (the ousted faction's: its own layer, see bannerLayer; the flat files show the Covenant's), two roofs burning, a League camp of striped tents on the slope. Near bank: a League standard-bearer (P1 pikeman), crossbowman and swordsman (back view) watch, long low-sun shadows.

panels.name: Covenant revolt
panels.scene: the same town and viewpoint at night (a before/after pair with panel 2). Jade banner on the gatehouse, jade pennants, the League's gold banner falling and burning, jade light in the gate and glowing vines on the wall, the League camp on fire. Townsfolk (P1 militia, spearmen, archers; front view, Covenant jade colourway) pour down the road with torches and jade lanterns; League pikeman + spearman rout (P1 rout frames), a dropped League standard trampled in the mud (rev 2: lifted 5 art px so it ends above the text band).

bleed.note: the game canvas is 1024x576 (src/main.js, pixelArt on). Use the -1024x576 file full-screen at 1:1 (it is the same art with 16/9 art px of extra scene on each side), or the 960x540 file centred at 1:1 with a 32/18 px frame. Do NOT scale 960x540 up to 1024x576 (x1.067 breaks the pixel grid).

size.art480: *-480x270.png is the raw art grid (1 art px = 1 px) for setScale(2). It lacks only the 1-native-px #54063a edge ring that the 2x files have, so prefer the 960/1024 files.

safeTextBox.note: only dark mud, grass and the near end of the road sit below y 396 (y 198 on the 480x270 grid). Rev 2: no outlined object (figure, post, banner, prop) has a pixel on art row 198 or below inside the box columns (checks.objectPxBelowY396InBox = 0 on both panels): the feet of the nearest figures, the lantern post base (was y ~404-422) and the dropped standard (was ~402-420) all end at y <= 395. Only frame foliage at the far left / right edge (outside the box) and the plain ground backdrop reach lower.
safeTextBox.rule: applies to every panel 1-12 (and 13): nothing that tells the story may sit below y 396 (960x540) / y 414 (1024x576) / y 198 (480x270)

style.method: hand-built in Python/numpy at art resolution (src/cutscenes/), no generated images. Figures are the real P1 puppets (src/figure.py, untouched) rendered at scene scale with the registry.js faction swaps (cloth1 + paint), so they are the same people as the battle sprites. Environment painted with ramp levels + 4x4 ordered dither, lit from the upper left like the sprites.
style.outline: every figure and near object: 1 art px #260a16 outline, outermost native px #54063a (exactly the engine.upscale rule); distant figures use a darker scene colour instead; buildings use #260a16 without the ring.
style.light: panel 2: low sun upper left, warm rim on the left edges of figures (+ engine rim), long shadows to the right. Panel 5: night grade on the backdrop, figures dropped 1-2 steps down their own ramps, right-edge rims in torch orange or jade.

palette.rule: final pass snaps every pixel to the union of the ramps below (sprite RAMPS + faction swaps + scene ramps + the two outline colours); offPalette = 0 checked in code.

variants.howTo: python3 src/cutscenes/export_p8.py rebuilds both panels, the panel-2 banner layers, panels.json and the previews (~70 s). Knobs: panel2.build(ousted='league'|'covenant'|'nightglass'|'brigand'|None) picks the falling banner (None = base layer); panel2.town(holder=, ousted=, gate=, fires=) picks whose banners hang, whose banner falls, the gate light and which roofs burn; panel2.HOUSES is the roofline (edit or reseed for a different town); SUN / panel5.MOON move the light; column() / crowd() take any P1 unit + faction + animation row; banners.banner(faction='league'|'covenant'|'nightglass'|'brigand', torn=, tilt=) draws any faction flag; scene.grade() + finish.snap() turn any panel into a night or dawn version.
examples: League takes a Nightglass town: town(holder='league', ousted='nightglass')
Covenant takes a League town by day: panel 2 with holder='covenant', ousted='league', column faction='covenant' (militia/spear units)
a calmer 'town held' still: fires=(), ousted=None

panel8TintGuidance.plan: panel 8 (a faction falls) will be one generic frame: the falling banner drawn on its own layer (layerConvention), everything else un-tinted. It ships both a pre-rendered banner-<faction> layer per faction (exact, preferred) and, for the game's current ramp-swap path, one neutral layer `banner` in the sprite paint ramp.
panel8TintGuidance.preferred: ramp swap, not multiply: the banner field uses the 6-step paint slot, so recolour it with figs.FACTION[f]['paint'] (League #2a1c0e..#f4d060, Covenant #0a1e18..#40b880, Nightglass #1a1428..#8a74d4) and the emblem with that faction's emblem mask. Exact palette, stays pixel-crisp.
panel8TintGuidance.ifPhaserTint: if it must be one PNG + setTint: author the banner in light greys (#e8e8e8 top step) so multiply keeps the values; tints League 0xf0c040, Covenant 0x48c890, Nightglass 0x8a74d4 (brigands 0xb0a090). Do not tint the sky, figures or outlines (#260a16 / #54063a must stay as they are), and keep the emblem as its own un-tinted cream layer.
panel8TintGuidance.mood: falling = late dusk: scene.grade(mul=(0.62, 0.58, 0.78)) on the backdrop, a little smoke, no other faction colour in frame so the tint carries the meaning.

layerConvention.rule: every panel that shows a faction's banner (any of 1-12, e.g. 2 conquest, 5 revolt, 6 decree, 8 a faction falls) ships that banner as its own swappable layer: a full-canvas transparent PNG per faction, alpha 0/255, registered to the panel at offset [0, 0], in all three sizes, plus a base file with no banner pixels (the area behind painted in). base + banner-<faction> == the full render (0 px). Each faction version uses only that faction's colours (+ outline and crossbar wood).
layerConvention.json: panels[].layers = { base: <1024 file>, banner-<faction>: <1024 file> } (what registry.js loads as p8-panel-<id>-<name>) + panels[].bannerLayer = { pick, composite, offset, bbox, files per size, colours, checks } as on panel 2
layerConvention.panel8: panel 8 is not drawn yet (on hold with panels 1-12 until Ronja approves the style). When it is: layers.base + layers.banner-<faction> as above, AND layers.banner = the same banner in the neutral sprite paint ramp (#3a1a1c..#e08e44) for ui/cutscene.js fallBannerKey(), which ramp-swaps p8-panel-8-banner to palette.factionSwaps[faction].paint today. Prefer the pre-rendered banner-<faction> layers (exact emblem and knob colours).
layerConvention.status: convention only; applies when panels 1-12 are drawn
